authoritative_for: Platter owns its canonical SQLite library: captured inputs, preparation runs, immutable content artifacts, explicit job eligibility, frozen editions, recorded delivery outcomes, settings and maintenance holds. Editions share one model; retained-material selection is an operation.

The product owns its schema-two Clockwork schedule definition and declares halt-until-approved. Clockwork owns failure-policy enforcement and retained scheduling incidents; product domain recovery remains separate.
not_authoritative_for: Cast owns discovery records. CRM owns career entries. Employer endpoints supply posting text. Nucleus owns execution. Email and Resend own submission acceptance. Gmail owns final receipt. Clockwork owns scheduled activation, durable scheduling halts, explicit continuation, incident notification and runtime process history.

covers: All Platter initialization, preparation, authorized daily preparation and delivery, ordinary and retained-material edition selection, explicit send, eligibility, export, local status, readiness, product-owned schedule-definition generation, migration and maintained installation outcomes.
excludes: Help/version, Clockwork activation management, automatic application submission, employer contact, CRM writes and final inbox delivery observation.

shared_access_and_trust: The current-user CLI operates private state. Models receive only captured source material and narrow requester tools. The installer publishes only Platter-owned command and provider selectors through Cell coordinated maintenance. A source bundle alone establishes neither an installed command nor send authority.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Original resume, captured CRM entries, posting text, model inputs/results, evidence references, PDFs, editions and send outcomes are private retained data. Nucleus/model processing receives career material; explicit send discloses the brief and resume attachments to Email, Resend and Gmail.
Clockwork incident notification discloses bounded operational metadata to the fixed Email recipient. Product content and private failure output are not copied into the notification.
compatibility_and_retirement: Preparation contract 4 and installation contract 3 require Clockwork schedule contract 3 for schema-two halt policy; private schema 2 remains unchanged. Explicit one-way import preserves predecessor IDs, exact requests and frozen deliveries. Old binaries cannot read schema two. Historical brief schemas remain supported.
operational_limits: Each edition contains up to three new ready packets. There is no candidate or token budget. Jobs use gpt-5.6-sol at max effort. run-daily needs applicable send authorization; it neither backfills dates nor resends accepted or uncertain editions. Activation is managed separately through Clockwork; stored 09:00 fields do not schedule work. Check source, runtime and rendering readiness separately.
